title: iLO 6 web interface input validation (SYN-CVE-2026-1105) (synthetic)
status: fix scheduled; iLO 6 v1.66 not yet in any baseline
text: SYN-CVE-2026-1105 affects the iLO 6 web interface in versions up to and including 1.64. It is fixed in iLO 6 v1.66, which is not yet part of a released baseline. System ROM updates do not remediate this issue. Mitigation: restrict iLO web access to the management VLAN.

title: DL380 Gen11 System ROM older than U54 v2.20 may log spurious memory errors (synthetic)
status: resolved in U54 v2.20 and later
text: DL380 Gen11 servers running System ROM U54 v2.16 or earlier may log correctable memory errors that trigger unnecessary DIMM replacement. Update to U54 v2.20 or later.
